Name: Tensor Processing Unit (TPU)
Description: Loosely-coupled AI/ML accelerator cluster: 8x CV32E40P RISC-V cores (RV32IMCFXpulpV2) with 128 KiB L1 TCDM, a systolic-array Tensor Processing Engine (TPE, 12x4 default, FP16/BF16/FP8 GEMM and GEMM-Ops, up to 384 ops/cycle) and an Activation Engine (AE, Softmax/GELU), memory-mapped over AXI4. Supported by the PULP GCC toolchain, pulp-runtime SDK and the MATCH domain-specific compiler. Implemented in GF12LP+ (0.54 mm2, 500 MHz) and on VCU118.
Comment: ISOLDE WI ID 3.4.01; IP cards live on GitHub (pulp-unibo/isolde_ip_cards).
